I'll never forgive Elastic for locking basic security features behind their paid licence. Over the years probably millions of people had their data compromised due to that (due to people inadvertently leaving instances on the public internet - having auth enabled by default would have helped a lot)

The default refresh rate for ES is a minute or so... This means when you index a document, it won't be returned when you search for it until a minute later when the index refreshes. But you can certainly change the configuration so it's practically real-time. There will be some performance hit though.
